name: audienzes-premium
description: Audience insight and live campaign data from Audienzes, read-only.

interface.longDescription: Audienzes Pro answers audience questions in ChatGPT and keeps the live campaign tools from the Audienzes connector. Describe a segment such as women 18-24 in Denmark and see which interests and themes over-index for it, on which platforms. Compare audience definitions side by side, check whether a segment can be addressed and where, see how interests combine or overlap, read what competitors claim in their ads, follow the direction of trends, see where an audience congregates and what it searches for, and get a behavioural archetype built from the evidence. Results are shown as percentages and indices, never head-counts. Where a platform cannot measure something, the answer says so instead of showing zero. Interpretations are labelled as interpretations. The connector also lists your connected advertising accounts and campaigns and reads impressions, clicks, spend, and daily trends. Usage is limited per hour. It never changes campaigns or anything in your accounts.
defaultPrompt: Which interests and sports over-index for women 18-24 in Denmark? Show the strongest ones by platform.
Compare men 18-24 and men 35-44 in Denmark on cycling, golf, and snowboarding. Which audience is genuinely different?
Are basketball, snowboarding, and cycling one audience or three for men 18-24 in Denmark?

positive.prompt: Which of these are Danish men 18-24 most into: basketball, snowboarding, cycling, yoga, golf? Show it by platform.
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked list of the five concepts with an index per platform. Platforms that cannot express a concept or an age range show a status such as not available, never 0. No head-counts.

positive.description: Resolve loose language to canonical concepts.
positive.prompt: What does "skisport" cover in your concept list?
positive.expected_behavior: Canonical concepts carrying "ski" (for example Alpine Skiing), marked as a compound match, with the platforms that can measure each.

positive.description: Check whether interests form one audience or several.
positive.prompt: Are basketball, snowboarding, and cycling one audience or three for men 18-24 in Denmark?
positive.expected_behavior: An answer on whether the interests combine into one audience or separate ones, stated as percentages or indices, with any interpretation labelled as interpretation.

positive.description: Check where a segment can be addressed.
positive.prompt: Can I address men 18-24 in Denmark who are into basketball? Check Meta, Reddit, Google, and Amazon.
positive.expected_behavior: A verdict per platform with an addressability band and a note where a platform cannot target age. Bands are not summed across platforms. No head-counts.

positive.description: Compare two audience definitions side by side.
positive.prompt: Compare women 18-24 and men 18-24 in Denmark on yoga, golf, cycling, and snowboarding on Meta, Instagram, and Pinterest.
positive.expected_behavior: The two definitions side by side per concept and platform, saying where they differ and where they do not.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for unrelated weather information.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Copenhagen tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not invoke the app to edit advertising campaigns.
negative.prompt: Increase my TikTok campaign budget to 500 EUR per day.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for news reporting.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of Audienzes Pro. Adds audience analysis to the Audienzes campaign tools. Results are percentages and indices, never head-counts. Never changes campaigns.
